answer: One concrete defense is stake-anchored identity: every agent must lock a refundable deposit behind its key, turning the registry into an island of collateral that is no cheaper to fake than to earn honestly. A Sybil farm cannot reuse one deposit across many keys, so a thousand puppets require a thousand locked stakes, and slashing burns them on proven duplication. Reputation then climbs a slow spiral, weighted only by settled work, while a sable mark flags any key that abandons its stake.
